name: Starbase Echo
_note: R1.3, Module R1 SSD book. THE SHEET DRAWS THE Y160 SHIP and tells you what to take away for an earlier one: prior to Y160, delete the drone rack and the ADD and reduce the BPV by 13. A refit can only ADD, so this file inverts that — the base IS the pre-Y160 station at 107 points with neither, and the Y160 refit puts them back for the 13 the sheet names. The drawn configuration is therefore the BS60 variant rather than the bare BS. No turnMode and no moveCost: a base rotates (C3.7) and the scenario sets the rate. The fighter and hangar MODULES are optional purchases and are out of this baseline.

refits.name: Y160 drone and ADD refit
refits.label: Y160 Refit
refits._note: Fits the type-D drone rack and the anti-drone system the sheet draws. The ADD always had twelve rounds and two reloads, so it arrives as an ADD_12 and the universal Y175 ADD_6 upgrade never applies to it.

refits.name: AWR refit
refits.label: AWR Refit
refits._note: Changes six APR to AWR. Available, but not always installed, in Y170 and later.

refits.name: Y170 refit
refits.label: Y170 Refit
refits._note: Requires the Y160 refit. Not because the sheet says so, but because a station still waiting for its drone rack in Y170 is not a configuration anyone fielded — and without the requirement the code BS70 would name both the Y170-alone ship and the Y160-plus-Y170 one, which RefitDataGuardTest refuses.

refits.name: Y175 refit
refits.label: Y175 Refit
refits._note: Cumulative with the Y170 refit: 21 base boxes, +9 at Y170, +5 more at Y175.
